name: BIG-Bench Extra Hard
description: Adversarially calibrated successor to BIG-Bench Hard, replacing each BBH task with a harder analog. Tests algorithmic, logical, linguistic, and commonsense reasoning.
creator: Google DeepMind

dataset.source: Adversarially hardened versions of 23 BBH tasks

notes: Best general model 23.9% (micro-avg), best reasoning model 54.2%. Created because BBH became saturated (90%+ for frontier models).
